description: Recovered fx2-cmix payload with the corrected ByteMixer multi-input scale and three learned semantic sidecar byte-distribution models. Sidecar direct and match models are disabled to isolate byte-model signal.

fixes: ByteMixer multi-input scaling uses float division
Sidecar byte models advance during dictionary pretraining
build.packaging: Minified Python xz bootstrap with check-free cmix.xz and english.dic.xz payloads.

hypothesis: The previous native sidecar-byte build was invalid as a byte-model test because ByteMixer zeroed inputs when more than two byte models were present. This variant isolates corrected learned sidecar byte distributions without sidecar direct/match overhead.
verdict: Reject at 1K gate. The corrected sidecar byte-distribution path is deterministic but archive-neutral against the parent while adding payload bytes.
